projects.title: ITQAN Friends Portal
projects.description: A comprehensive community management portal with role-based access and Google Drive integration.
projects.overview: ITQAN Friends is a full-stack community management platform built to handle member resources, secure document sharing, and administrative oversight.
projects.problem: The community relied on scattered Google Drive folders and WhatsApp groups to manage members and resources, leading to lost files and zero access control.
projects.solution: Built a centralized portal using Next.js App Router, Firebase Authentication, and a custom integration with the Google Drive API to securely serve documents based on user roles.
projects.architecture: Next.js 14 (App Router) for Server Components and SEO. Firebase Auth for session management. Firestore for NoSQL user data. Google Drive API for zero-cost secure file storage.
projects.challenges: Implementing secure role-based access control (RBAC) across server components and client components without causing hydration mismatches or layout shifts.
projects.outcome: Successfully migrated 100+ active members to the new platform, reducing resource discovery time by 80% and providing admins with a secure dashboard.
projects.lessonsLearned: Deepened my understanding of Next.js Server Actions and how to securely pass JWT tokens to external APIs (Google Drive) without exposing service account credentials to the client.

projects.title: Enterprise Homelab Infrastructure
projects.description: An enterprise-grade bare-metal virtualized environment for self-hosting services securely.
projects.overview: A fully self-hosted, virtualized environment using Proxmox VE to manage multiple containers and VMs securely behind a reverse proxy and firewall.
projects.problem: Relying on expensive third-party cloud hosting for development environments and personal services became unsustainable and lacked privacy.
projects.solution: Built a local enterprise-grade server environment using a bare-metal hypervisor, containerized services, and robust network segmentation.
projects.architecture: Proxmox VE on bare metal. TrueNAS for ZFS storage pools. pfSense for firewall/VLANs. Nginx Proxy Manager for SSL and reverse proxying to Docker containers.
projects.challenges: Configuring secure VLANs to separate IoT devices from the management network and recovering a corrupted ZFS pool after a power failure.
projects.outcome: Reduced monthly cloud hosting costs by 100% while increasing available compute power and gaining deep systems administration experience.
projects.lessonsLearned: Learned the critical importance of automated off-site backups (using Proxmox Backup Server) and proper firewall rule ordering in pfSense.

projects.title: Vogue Vault
projects.description: A high-performance E-commerce catalog with custom filtering and 60 FPS animations.
projects.overview: Vogue Vault is an interactive, highly-optimized E-commerce catalog built to demonstrate complex client-side filtering without compromising frame rates.
projects.problem: Many e-commerce sites suffer from layout thrashing and dropped frames when users rapidly toggle product filters.
projects.solution: Implemented a custom React-based filtering engine combined with Framer Motion layout transitions to ensure buttery smooth catalog updates.
projects.architecture: React SPA with Tailwind CSS for utility styling. Context API for global state. Framer Motion for hardware-accelerated layout transitions.
projects.challenges: Maintaining 60 FPS layout re-renders during rapid multi-property category filtering by optimizing component memoization.
projects.outcome: Achieved a visually striking, zero-jank filtering experience that feels instantaneous to the user.
projects.lessonsLearned: Mastered the use of React.memo, useMemo, and useCallback to prevent unnecessary re-renders in deep component trees during state updates.
